headline: Zoning changes on nonconforming uses, motel-hotel height limits, and use regulations in the city code.
summary: Councillors will discuss changes to rules for nonconforming uses, lots, buildings and structures. They will also discuss setting the maximum height for motel-hotels at 6 stories, not to exceed 75 ft.
items: Amend Code of the City of Malden 12.28.010(E) on nonconforming uses, lots, buildings and structures (325-26)
Set motel-hotel maximum height at 6 stories, not to exceed 75 ft, in Code 12.16.010 (445-26)
location: Room 105, Malden City Hall, 215 Pleasant Street, Malden, MA 02148
